claim.statement: Current Lovable documentation says an owner or admin can authorize OAuth, install the Lovable GitHub App for all or selected repositories, connect one project to one repository, and enable two-way synchronization on the default branch.

source.title: Connect your project to GitHub
source.locator: Before you connect and Set up the GitHub integration

limitations: The documentation does not establish the execution principal or commit attribution of a particular synchronized change.
unknowns: OAuth identity, App installation, repository scope, linked repository, branch and synchronization state are unknown.
